title: Holiday Video Maker for Gift Season | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one product link into a holiday video that feels festive, with a script, an AI avatar, and a voice. Post the gift ad before the ship-by date is final.
h1: Make a Festive Holiday Video From a Link
lead: Turn a product link into a holiday video that feels festive, with a script, a lifelike AI avatar, and a voice you choose.

faq.q: Can I make holiday videos for many products?
faq.a: Yes. Make a holiday video for each product from its photo or page link. Batch several items to save time, then review each result.

faq.q: Can I publish my holiday video to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Download your holiday video for TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook. You can also send it from the tool and set the ad budget on the platform.

faq.q: Can I add holiday music and visuals?
faq.a: Yes. Add seasonal visuals and a music track that fits the holiday. You can make a gift ad without filming a new scene.

faq.q: Can I reuse my holiday video next season?
faq.a: Yes. Your finished videos stay in your account to download again. Change the offer, date, or message to make next season's version.

faq.q: How do credits work for holiday videos and photos?
faq.a: A photo costs 24 credits; a 6, 10, 15, or 30 second video costs 24, 40, 60, or 120. Starter costs $24.50 monthly for 200 credits, Pro $35 for 300, and Premium $63 for 600. Failed jobs return their credits.

faq.q: Can my own tools ask for a holiday ad?
faq.a: Yes. Your software can start holiday ad jobs through the API using product links. Review each finished video before publishing.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a product link to bring its image and details into the holiday ad. You can upload a clearer photo if you prefer.

faq.q: Can an AI avatar deliver the holiday message?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI actor to deliver your holiday message with a voice. You can make a festive product ad without hiring a presenter.

trust.lead: Six checks on credits, privacy, and the gift scene before a holiday ad goes out.

items.d: The download has no watermark, so a holiday ad can run as a paid placement. Each app still has its own rules.
